title: The lesson opens on a monarch butterfly landing on a milkweed leaf and laying an egg, then asks what will happen next. Using the anchor, students connect the egg to the caterpillar, chrysalis, and butterfly stages they already partly know, then come to see these as one repeating cycle rather than four separate animals or a line that stops. The lesson closes by asking the learner to tell what must happen for the cycle to begin again. (P09 edit)
